verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair question for an AI coding assistant, but the evidence pack has no Aider setting, policy, or documentation about training on user code or prompts. Support for local models via Ollama is an adjacent workaround that keeps data local. It is not an opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can opt out of having my code and prompts used for AI model training
